authority: Binds supplied independently authenticated human ratings and coordinator seal to selected encrypted custody and source-purpose controls. It does not judge outputs, invent reviewer approval, choose criteria, create actual ratings or establish learned capability.
failure_or_lesson: A collector can infer arm identity from labeled run plaintext without opening the identity key. Ancestor grants can also become a direct read bypass if purposes are unrestricted. Keep pre-seal collection on spec/blind-pack artifacts, constrain its read purpose, derive durable rating IDs from assignments, recheck every gathered rating and verify an independent signed complete seal before any internal key read.
goal: Connect blind human assessment to the chosen physical infrastructure and enforce durable signed-seal ordering before private identity release.
notes: Public method trace only. Actual reviewer recruitment, model outputs, final cohort, numerical criteria and human judgments remain absent. Existing comparison public read now denies all key access and limits comparison_assessment purposes to assessment artifacts; producer/backend credentials remain outside blind reviewer scope.
procedure: Register an exact materialized spec against the actual producer run and permitted review pack; keep blind recovery off labeled outputs; authenticate and copy actual submissions with deterministic run/collection/assignment identities; store immutable encrypted records through canonical Kurrent/source registration and XTDB references; recover expected assignments and recheck each current permission; obtain independent coordinator signature over the complete reconstructed collection; store a seal capsule linked to every rating; compare durable individual records with that capsule; only then invoke the internal current-purpose key hook, validate actual mapping and failure matrix, and recheck all release permissions before returning.
validation: Eleven local component regressions passed with encrypted objects and explicit comparison/permission fixtures. A real XTDB/KurrentDB/encrypted custody test is implemented and syntax-checked but awaits combined CI; no actual human study, trained model or behavioral advantage was exercised.
